name: Forellenhof
beschreibung:
Set amidst picturesque natural scenery in Schwendt at the foot of the Kaiser mountains, the traditional Forellenhof welcomes visitors with genuine Tyrolean charm. The inn is renowned for freshly caught trout specialties and cosy guest rooms.

Peaceful surroundings invite hiking, cycling, visits to Lake Walchsee, and extensive cross-country skiing in winter.
kurzbeschreibung: Forellenhof in Schwendt offers relaxing holidays in Kaiserwinkl with regional dining and on-site trout breeding.
